images.alt: Dense mangrove foliage and upright breathing roots beside a muddy tidal creek in Bhitarkanika.
A large saltwater crocodile resting on a muddy bank beneath mangrove trees in Bhitarkanika.
Two white-throated kingfishers with chestnut heads, red bills and bright turquoise wings perched on a branch.
A common kingfisher with a blue head and orange breast holds a small fish while perched among reeds.
A black-capped kingfisher perched on a stump, showing its black head, white collar, red bill and blue wings.
A white little egret bends its slender black bill toward the water while wading on dark legs.
A Brahminy kite in flight with a white head, chestnut wings and dark outer flight feathers.
